purpose: Successor trigger-aware monitoring horizon for RMD after the BNR/CMFB topology reopen, OECD non-consolidated topology pass, exact-row failure, ESA2010 semantic reopen, semantic-adjusted reconciliation failure and dissemination-precision diagnostic. It preserves event-conditioned monitoring while preventing repeated source probing after all currently admissible paths have returned to Evidence-Triggered Baseline Hold.

horizons.trigger: Actually observed non-zero BNR policy-rate change in the reserved prospective window.
horizons.action_if_no_trigger: Record unchanged-rate event only; do not inspect MIR response values and return to baseline hold.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Open Stage 1 driver-side diagnostic only. Preserve frozen candidate and beta. Do not inspect same-month MIR response before official release.

downstream_release_gate.rule: The October-reference MIR response may be inspected only on or after 2026-12-02 and only if October contains a non-zero policy-rate event.

horizons.next_check_condition: European Commission publishes the Autumn 2026 full macroeconomic forecast / corresponding AMECO full release.
horizons.trigger: A genuinely new full AMECO vintage materially changes the admissible real-time UBLGBPS structural-primary history or supplies new identification-relevant evidence.
horizons.action_if_release_occurs: Archive and adjudicate the new vintage under a new preregistered source cycle before any modelling decision.
horizons.action_before_release: No repeated AMECO probing; remain in baseline hold.

horizons.trigger: BNR exposes the exact official 2025-Q2 BLS workbook endpoint or an exact machine-readable time-series/catalog target with matching realised-round semantics.
horizons.action_without_new_evidence: Do not repeat filename/timestamp guessing, indexed search loops or rounded-report substitution.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Reopen source materialisation only; retain exact bytes and semantics before any credit-equation work.

horizons.trigger: An official or reproducible source supplies same-boundary opening principal, realised repriced/refinanced principal and matched old/new effective rates across material debt blocks.
horizons.action_without_new_evidence: Do not reinterpret marginal maturity/refixing indicators as a matched repricing ledger.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Repass the frozen ledger completeness and identification gates only.

horizons.trigger: A changed official ECB/Eurostat/BNR/OECD dataset topology or genuinely new official source supplies the frozen RMD bilateral/counterparty boundary, including required sectors, instruments, quarterly stocks and financial transactions.

current_known_release_context.rule: A routine new quarterly data vintage alone is not a reopen trigger. Check only for demonstrable topology/coverage change, not merely new observations.

horizons.action_without_topology_change: Do not rerun exhausted historical source probes.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Preregister a new source-topology recovery pass and repass only the affected Accounting Spine/reference-mode gates.

horizons.trigger: An official domain-specific financial-accounts dissemination rule quantitatively defines precision, rounding, balancing tolerance or exact published-value reconciliation semantics for the OECD/ECB/BNR public boundary, or a changed public source supplies exact values that satisfy the frozen aggregate identity.
horizons.action_without_new_evidence: Do not rerun the semantic-adjusted OECD value gate, do not change the 0.1 million RON historical threshold, and do not shorten or shift the historical window after observing results.
horizons.action_if_trigger: Create a new preregistered precision/balancing assessment first. Only if that independent assessment passes may one new value/reconciliation gate be designed; historical failed gates remain immutable.
